plan.notes: Source: official Lone Star College 'Computer Science AS Major (AS_FCSC) — Full-Time Pathway Plan, 2026 Fall' (https://www.lonestar.edu/departments/admissions/AS_FCSC.pdf), Total Plan Credits 60, retrieved 2026-09-30. TRUE degree name verified on lonestar.edu: 'Associate of Science Field of Study: Computer Science' (Programs-of-Study page https://www.lonestar.edu/Programs-Of-Study/comp-sci-field.htm — an Academic Transfer degree leading to a BS); the pathway plan itself is titled 'Computer Science AS Major (AS_FCSC)'. The '2026 Fall' plan corresponds to academic year 2026-2027. Transcription method: manual transcription from the official PDF text, cross-checked against the 2023 Fall edition of the same plan (AS_FCSC CG.pdf). Caveats: (1) The PDF's text layer reads 'Semester Total 12' for Semester 1, but its course rows sum to 15 (3+1+4+4+3) and the plan's own 60-credit total is met only at 15+14+4+14+13; the 2023 Fall edition prints 15 for the identical semester — transcribed here at 15. (2) Semester 5 prints both 'CORE Language, Philosophy & Culture (40) 3' and 'An ACGM Course 3'; with the printed Semester Total 13 only one 3-credit slot fits, so it is encoded as a single choice slot (choose one ACGM course in core category 040) — consistent with the 2023 edition where that row expands into the full OR option list. (3) Terms: the PDF numbers semesters 1-5 without naming Fall/Spring/Summer; terms here follow the standard full-time reading (the single-course MATH 2414 semester as Summer Year 1). (4) Prerequisites verified from official LSC sources: COSC 1437←COSC 1436 and COSC 2436←COSC 1437 (LSC catalog addenda); MATH 2305←MATH 2413 and MATH 2318←MATH 2414 (catalog.lonestar.edu course descriptions); MATH 2413←MATH 2412 (the plan's own zero-credit pre-requisite block; LSC catalog); COSC 2325←COSC 1436, MATH 2414←MATH 2413, PHYS 2425←MATH 2413, PHYS 2426←PHYS 2425, ENGL 1302←ENGL 1301 (TCCNS/ACGM standard sequencing, satisfied by the plan's term order). CHEM 1411's catalog prerequisites are placement/readiness-based (MATH 0310 or placement; CHEM 1405 or HS chemistry), not in-plan courses — encoded with no prereq. MATH 2412 (Precalculus) is the plan-named placement-prep prerequisite and is listed in external_prereqs (MATH 1314/1316 feed into it per the LSC catalog and appear in the plan's zero-credit block).
